name: Nova Klúbburinn hf.
summary: Nova Klúbburinn hf. operates as a telecommunications company in Iceland. It provides mobile and fiber optic services, as well as telecommunications services. The company also engages in radio and television broadcasting and programming activities. In addition, it offers mobile phones, smart devices, headphones, speakers, and accessories. The company distributes its products through its stores and online. Nova Klúbburinn hf. was formerly known as Platínum Nova hf. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Reykjavík, Iceland.
